open_questions: When was lisinopril first started, at what dose, and has the dose changed since? The record only shows it continuing at 10 mg each morning.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Home blood pressure readings around 150/90 are recorded while on lisinopril 10 mg.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Review the home blood pressure log and current readings with the clinician at the next visit.

check_points.text: Check whether kidney function and potassium have been checked after starting or changing the lisinopril dose; no such results appear in the record.
